snippet.title: PlayStation - Pebble Beach no Hatou Plus (1996)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Pebble Beach no Hatou Plus is a Sports game, developed by T&E Soft and published by Soft Bank, which was released in Japan in 1996.
